claim: No statement about zeros. Format step only. (2.2) of MS Prop. 2.1 is used pointwise: H holomorphic, bounded on Re s >= 2, and not vanishing to the order of L at one top-layer zero (Lemma U1, proved). Ladder lemma (proved relative to Lemma H and the format hypotheses on levels G_f, f -> 6f+6, which have no source for infinite-order targets): beta(0) <= max(sigma_0, 3/5 + (2/5)6^-k); on all levels the supremum is <= sigma_0 or in [4/7, 3/5]. Ceiling 2/3 becomes 3/5, not 1/2; below 3/5 the needed input is a common-zero exclusion in the window (open, not reachable by counting). Second normaliser character via eta^sigma exists except for eta = 1, chi o N. Target-blind: Liouville, THIN, sign twists have the same normaliser zeros. Server not used; unrefereed.
followUp: Decide whether the format can be posed for targets alpha^6 chi (derive MS (7.10)-(7.13) with the angular factor in the archimedean weight); two referees on Lemma U1 and Theorem A.
